acceptance_limit: Numerical closure is reported without tolerance/pass threshold. Component RMS values are never subtracted. CPP other_raw is not independent causal evidence.

baseline_observer_noninterference.scope: Current PR302 Full physical rates vs archived PR301 same-input rates for FT and CPP independently; measured fieldwise with owner masks, no bitwise pass requirement.

current_source_full_parser_crosscheck.meaning: same-file serialization parser check, not state-equality gate

same_call_add_closure.mix_after_horizontal_vs_add_tendf_before: raw uncoupled t_tendf basis; conversion to physical K/s divides by c1h*mut+c2h

thm_add_formula_vs_after_physical_K_per_.units: K/s after msfty/(c1h*mut+c2h); same state makes product-rule term cancel in this closure

thm_add_formula_vs_after_raw_basis.units: raw t_tend basis before Full-THM physical mass conversion; do not read as K/s

same_call_add_closure.thm_advection_after_vertical_vs_add_befo: raw t_tend basis before physical conversion

packed_17x17x17_raw_alias_diagnostic_onl.interpretation: extra 17th i/j elements are not assumed semantically equivalent; diagnostic only, not gated or used for primary attribution

omega_precision.units: Pa/s; diagnostic only, no cross-precision equality gate

physical_units_and_owners.mu_dot: DMDT + forcing-only mu_tend from paired Full V2 snapshot, Pa/s
physical_units_and_owners.ph_conversion: msfty*ph_tend/(c1f*mut+c2f), m^2/s^3; no PH*mu_dot product rule
physical_units_and_owners.ph_owner: bottom interface fixed/excluded, top included iff top_lid=false; 4096 when top_lid=false
physical_units_and_owners.thm_conversion: FT: linear t_tend uses msfty/(c1h*mut+c2h), captured uncoupled t_tendf diffusion/addition uses 1/(c1h*mut+c2h), then add -t*c1h*mu_dot/(c1h*mut+c2h) once. CPP theta_total_raw already carries msfty, so each CPP component uses 1/theta_mass_denom and the product term is -t*theta_mass_tend/theta_mass_denom. t is perturbation theta.
